Hi,

So what Infernum is doing here, is offering "Items" that will give the players who pay Real Money, an advantage over the other players during the game. so if that is not "Pay-To-Win", so I don't know what to call it.

I know that Infernum needs to pay the bills of this game and make a profit, but there are many other MMOGs, that don't give the players who pay "Real Money" any advantage during the gameplay, and still they manage to pay the bills and make a profit while they have millions of players and they are online for years, for example games like (Path Of Exile) which only offers cosmetic upgrades for real money.

And here are a few examples on how this game is turning to be a "Pay-To-Win":

1- The 6-stars clothes and accessories, which gives the players who pay "Real Money" more armor, luck, XP bonus and FP bonus, more than the average Items that u buy with FPs.

- My Suggestion: Offer those items to be purchased with FPs too, but make it expensive, and by this u will still have many players who will buy it with tokens.

2- Upgrade Gems, the elite gems have a success rate of 100%, while the average gems have a success rate between 0%-10%, I recently bought 90 large Equipment gems, and all i got is only 2 upgrades (that's about 2%), also i bought 100 large weapon gems and all I got is 1 upgrade (that's 1%), and I'm not even close to fully upgrade my Items, and some times i get 0% success rate, so by that rate I'll need that million FPs prize so I can "MAYBE" fully upgrade my stuff!

- My Suggestion: Increase the success rate of the average gems to 50% (That's half the success rate of the elite Gems), and make it more expensive.

3- Premium Account, in which they offer the players who pay real money many benefits that will give them an advantage, such as Auto-Healing item, item that will make the re-spawn time shorter, an extra 10% bonus on XP and FPs, additional map slots, extra weapon slots...etc.

- My Suggestion: I don't know from where to begin, but in short, just make all those items purchasable by Force points too, but make it insanely expensive.

4- Weapons, many of the best weapons of this game are purchasable by Tokens Only, for example:-
- Best Secondaries: Piranha & Pistol Crossbow
- Best Melees (Too many to mention) but here is a couple: Fire Dragon Flame Sword & Griffon's Lantern
- Best Specials (There are many better than Poisonous bomb, I've seen them in a Tokens only special offers) But what I see currently in the shop is: Big Bang 400
- Best Main (Heavy): Hellfire Crossbow & Drake 2000
- Best Main (Long): Reindeer Crossbow (can be bought with both Tokens (lvl27) and FPs (lvl46)).
- I see the best light and medium weapons are purchasable by both tokens and FPs (Except for a Few tokens only special offers)

- My Suggestion: make all the weapons purchasable with both tokens and FPs, but make it expensive to buy with FPs.

5- Special offers, it's a little bit unfair, Lets compare the special offers that u can buy with tokens and the ones u can buy with FPs, most of the time we see them offering in exchange of tokens only, Rare and fully upgraded clothes, accessories, weapons, Bundles. which we "RARELY" see them offering them to be purchased with FPs.

- My Suggestion: make the special offers available to be bought with both tokens and FPs, but make it expensive to buy with FPs.

6- Weapons Durability, which a problem that all the players have, Infernum says it's to make the game more "realistic", "realistic" my rear end, how many square headed tiny ppl u see in real life, and what about using a "Real" weapons names, or using a real bullets effects, instead of a Paint-Gun bullets, or a real blood..... again "realistic" my rear end, this is only another way to rip off the players hard earned in-game money. I once paid over 500FPs to fix my weapons after 1 match, and i paid 70 FPs to fix my melee even though I didn't swing it once, all I did was pulling it out a few times while I was changing my weapons.

- My Suggestion: remove this system completely, or at least if u want to keep this "Realistic" system, just make it less expensive.

- The Conclusion:
If Infernum kept giving the players who pay real money an "Items" that will give an advantage over the other players during the game, that will drive many players away from this game, I mean why to waste my time and play this game for months, while other players can buy items that will give an advantage, plus I can't buy those items with in-game money?

So the main idea is to offer all the items in this game to be purchased with both Tokens and Force Points, but make it more expensive to buy with FPs. and u will get more players and the more players u have the more players are willing to pay money.

So please share with us all your thoughts and opinions about this.

Thanks.

title: How gems should work, still balanced

I think that for each tier of upgrade you add to a property there should be a decrease in it's chances of completing that is entirely scale able with the tier of the gem. this is how i think it should work
1up property: small gem 100% success, medium gem 100% success, large gem 100% success
2up property: small gem 66% success chance, medium gem 83% success chance, large gem 90% success chance

Yeah, the US server is pretty close to becoming officially dead.
We all know that. But Infernum doesn't seem to be doing anything about it. The server's had its ups and downs when it comes to regular players, but now there are hardly any rooms in Play, and a similar amount of people in Build.

How do we fix this? I'm not into game management, but I'm pretty sure that new Weapons (Which, I will add, are now just re-skins of older ones) and pre-order offers aren't gonna cut it. We need to both attract new players, and keep them. Any new joining player will probably quit after a week or so because this "Free-to-Play" game is stocked with ridiculous token offers. I thought Brick Force was moving away from PTW?

What's done is done, but I do have a few ideas to help limit the power on things and keep the game more friendly to new users. The first is a list of possible Room Options that can help:

All Modes (Excluding Freefall):

- Gold/Rare Limit - Simply, allow or disallow the use of Golds and Rares. This may have to be tweaked, though. I can easily see anyone without a Gold or Rare abusing this so they don't have to put up with the weapons.

- Armor On/Off - Just what the name says. Allow or disallow armor points, though other clothing boosts will still take effect.

- Kick Vote Allow/Disallow - People were complaining about Kick Vote, I don't know if it was removed, but here's a possible solution.

Build & Destroy:

- Gravity On/Off - Someone (I don't remember who) complained about Gravity ruining Build&Destroy. I'm sure other people feel the same way, too.

- Turrets Option - Allow or disallow the placement of turrets.

- Portals Option - Allow or disallow Portals. This may be combined with either of the other 2.

Okay, some of these are dumb options, I admit it. But it's all I got. Tell me what can be tweaked.

There are a LOT of complaints about weapons which kill people in several seconds, which is especially a problem with PTW players. I'm not sure exactly how to make this fairer, but I think that increasing the rate at which players earn FP can help with this. That way, they'll have more money faster, allowing them to better keep up with Token-users.

Also, I think that we shouldn't keep putting Pick'nWin weapons/items in the shop. Pick'nWin things are meant to be earned by means of using coins and getting lucky, NOT spending REAL MONEY to keep them permanently.

The new weapons (I think most everyone will agree) should be less of re-skins and more original designs. Why can't you just scroll around the forums? There are plenty of originals. The first set of re-skins were actually cool, the second was "eh", and from then on it just got irritating. And the colored "next generations" are laughable. Also, can we AVOID making super-powerful weapons with every new set?

(I'm not really a professional here. What're your ideas for fixing the server?)

Now, how exactly would we go about this? Clearly there's light from the sky (Which SHOULD be made darker on nighttime maps), but aside from that, how dark should it have to go? If we go pitch-black like Minecraft, maps that utilize the current light will be EXTREMELY dark. It needs to be dark enough to make out figures, at least.

But are we going to have EVERY glowing brick as a light source? Or just decoration ones that glow? (Lasers, Gravity, ect.)

From what I can tell, the easiest thing to do is basically do the same as Minecraft: just make the squares of the surface of bricks gradually get darker the farther away they are from the light source. (Then fuzzy up the edges a bit, just for a bit more realism)


Now, I'm no animator, (At least, not yet) so I have no idea what will and won't work.

As for the balance issue, I'm not exactly the go-to guy. It'd be a bit difficult trying to de-power some weapons without getting some paying players REALLY ticked off.

My suggestion is that the rate at which FP is earned increases. At least to enough that non-paying players can get somewhere at a reasonable rate. Either that, and/or, I can repeat what I've said numerous times: When a new weapon is added, give it some time for Tokens only (About a month, I'd say), then shift it to both FP and Tokens. That way, the less-patient players can get what they want (And the money is paid for it), and everyone who can wait can have it later on.

Anyway, Hardcore mode I can see going either way. There are some people (Like me) who are willing to suck it up against a PTW opponent, or just want to go crazy with their new equipment. The only way to REALLY see what would happen would be to experiment with it in-game.

No images yet, but I think there should be 4 versions of this block (One for each Season); all the same in function, just different models for different map styles.

Season 1 - A full-block sized wooden crate, resembling the black crate, but tan in color.
Season 2 - Cylindrical, blue, futuristic capsule. The top and bottom caps would be grey metal and be connected by handle-like structures.
Season 3 -A wooden chest with golden rims and a red jewel lock.
Season 4 - A brown barrel, resembling the existing one but darker in color with a metal top/bottom.

Pressing E next to the box in build mode would let builders determine each individual box's contents, and the number of that item. Upon destroying the box, their contents would drop onto the floor and could be picked up with G. - Health Pot (30-HP, 50-HP, 100-HP)
- Ammunition (Specific weapon type, or reload whatever player is holding. Comes in packs of 10, 20, 50, or 75)
- Sprint Can (Immediately refills sprint bar / Starts 5-second sprint without consuming the bar)

- Weapon (Choose 1 of 6; 1 weapon choice for each category. Not overpowered ones, but good enough to be useful. Ex. Big Bang, Scarab, Toy Hammer, ect. Same rules apply as taking another person's weapon.)

I can understand if this wouldn't be easy to program, but I think it would be a fun concept when utilized correctly.

I've been keeping this idea for a long time. A very long time. I first got it in a thread started by S17MON, where he and I had a ridiculously long debate over whether or not the Medieval theme should be implemented.

When he said this:
Also, Season 2 was the space theme, so the last season should be the distant future theme. They're not the same, although quite similar.
I thought, why can't we have Season 5 - BrickWars?

No, this isn't just Star Wars with bricks. Imagine a futuristic (possibly apocalyptic) wartime setting. Kind of like a Season 1 and Season 2 combined.

After 2 seasons of older-style weapons, I think we should go future again, but this time with the wartime twist. Imagine - futuristic military gear, hand-held war lasers, energy swords, and grenades only possible with a future theme that we missed out on in S2. I might go into details later on, but I think I know the real reason most people came here: Boss Mode.

(I've heard of some sort of "Titan Mode" a while back, but at the moment I see no signs of that idea coming up again.)

Anyway, I've come up with 2 relatively simple bosses for B-F: The Brick Turret and the Bomber Queen. These bosses would probably have their own default maps, as to not rig a map to farm XP and FP from the boss.

This is a cooperative mode for all players; maximum of 4. No mid-game joining. The XP and FP earned from this mode would depend on how much health was depleted from the boss before the players lost, or (If the players won) how much time is still on the clock, as well as difficulty setting and the number of players (More players = slightly less FP/XP). Players would each get 3 lives, and would lose when the timer ran out, or every player has lost each of their lives. (Players who run out would go into spectator mode like in Defusion.)
As (sort of) mentioned, there would be a difficulty setting that would determine the health and damage for the boss. (Difficulties rate from 1 to 5) Time is also changeable, but giving yourself more time results in less FP.

When only a certain amount of health is remaining, each boss has its own ways of becoming tougher for the players to defeat.

Remind me if there's anything I forgot to cover; but here's the details of each boss.

Brick Turret

This one is probably the simpler one. The Brick-Turret is a silver and gold tower-like structure, about 7 blocks high, with - you guessed it - a turret on top of it. The turret would have four wide and long barrels, similar to the Vulcan Turret without the gatling gun features.

The catch would be the hitboxes. There are 4 glass chambers, about the size of a Brickman's head turned sideways, attached to the side of the tower. Normally these are gold - but they can only be attacked when they turn blue. Any damage on the gold chambers would be resisted entirely.

The Brick-Turret has an array of five attacks. Each attack it randomly switches to a different player as a target. The attacks are as followed, activated in a random order:
- Machine Gun - The boss fires at the target in a machine-gun fashion. You can't move out of the line of fire, but it would have a wide spread to avoid instant player death.
- Grapeshot - This is a shotgun-like attack with a wide area of effect, but in return less damage than the Machine Gun. Shoots twice. Hard to avoid without cover.
- Bazooka - The boss will pause before launching 4 rockets straight at the target in not-so quick succession. This attack will pick a target location before firing, so players can sprint out of the area of effect.
- Grenade Launcher - The boss lobs 4 grenades in quick succession at the target player. They won't be as fast as the bazooka rockets, but can fly over obstacles and deal greater damage.
- Missile Launcher - The boss will launch several missiles into the air, which will come crashing down on each player in the same fashion as the bombs in Freefall mode, but much quicker and with a smaller effect radius.

After using each of these attacks once, the Turret will stop working for a short time, and the glass weakpoints will become vulnerable until the next array of attacks. This repeats until the boss is dead.

At 1/2 or Less Health:
The turret's guns will spin around quickly and turn red for a moment, signaling that it's at half health.
- All attacks now have slightly boosted damage and are faster.
- 25% less time that weakpoints are vulnerable.

At 1/4 or Less Health:
The turret's guns will spin again, and smoke will burst from them as well.
- All attacks now shoot twice as many times as before.
- Another 25% less time that weakpoints are vulnerable.

Bomber Queen

The Bomber Bee Queen. What were you going to expect? She resembles an average bomber bee, though substantially bigger, (Bigger even than the "bosses" in Defense mode) and purple in color. She has a fancy crown on top of her as well as a scepter-like structure with a bomb on top of it.

The Bomber Queen has a different strategy than the Turret. First things first, the attack list:
- Bee Dive-Bomb - An attack almost identical to the bombs in Freefall, though again faster.
- Minion Assault - The Queen summons a red, quick-moving bee minion for each player, which moves only in a straight line and explodes when shot at enough or when close enough to a player or brick.
- Tracker Assault -Similar to the above attack, but this bee is blue and is much slower, homing in on the target player. It has much higher health and explodes under the same conditions.
- Army Bee - Red or Blue at random; color doesn't matter. This bee resembles the boss with the army hat in Defense mode. It will track down a target player, but will also launch machine gun fire in 3-second bursts occasionally until its destruction.
- Apocalypse Bee - By far the rarest attack. The boss will summon the "Champion" boss from Defense Mode, which will hover down slowly until it touches a brick, resulting in immediate deaths for all players. The only way to stop it is to shoot it down before it hits the ground.

The Bomber Queen tries to stay high in the air, if at all possible. Like the Turret, she is protected from all attacks with a shield, but hers is deactivated differently - there are 4 green "Shield Bees" in the boss area that produce the shield when at least one is present. Players must shoot down each of these before attacking the boss. And yes, after a while they will Re-spawn and must be killed again. Meanwhile, the Queen will be bombarding the players with attacks with short pauses between each strike.

At 1/2 or Less Health:
To signal this, the Queen will make a buzzing sound and "angry" smoke will burst from her head.
- Attack damage boosted by 25%

At 1/4 or Less Health:
The Queen will angrily buzz again, and will begin blinking red for a short time.
- 3x the number of bees originally summoned for first 3 attacks listed - summoned one after another.
- Attack radii are 33% larger.
- Time between attacks shortened.

I've got another boss for you all:

Brick-Titan 5k

This boss wasn't mentioned in the first post, if you haven't already noticed. It would be substantially
more complex than the other two, and the battlefield would be a (mostly) flat 15x15-block large top of a tower. As for appearance, he's this robot: http://media-curse.cursecdn.com/atta...fense_mode.jpg

Attacks:
- Ballistic Fury - The gun on the Titan's shoulder would randomly select 2 player targets, and would spray heavily-damaging bullets in a wide cone at those targets for 7 seconds.
- Hell's Rain - Launches 7 missiles into the air for each player. Missiles come crashing down on the platform quickly and randomly, each having a large blast radius.
- Artillery Tracker - The boss would summon 3 helicopter-like bombs (Similar to the ones in the image) for each player. They would then track down a player and explode when damaged enough or coming into contact with a player or brick. (VERY high health.)
- Titan's Drill - The Brick-Titan would hover to the platform and stab his drill into the center, holding it there for 8 seconds, damaging players close enough every second. (The drill would take up the better fraction of the platform.)
- Repair-O-Tron - Summons 3 Bomber Bee-sized robots that float around the boss, slowly recovering its health. They can only be destroyed by being dealt enough damage. If repair-bots are already present, then it will only summon enough to have 3 robots.
- Anti-Matter Missile - Brick-Titan will charge with yellow energy for a moment, then launch a single large missile into the air. The missile will target a player randomly, and will come crashing down like the bombs in Freefall. Upon exploding, the missile deal heavy damage and will remove all bricks within a 2-block radius of its contact point. (This attack would only be used 6 times, once when the boss is at 5/6-full health, once at 4/6-5/6 health, and so on.)
- Atomic Fission - The boss will open its mouth and a large, red energy sphere would start to form, gaining more power every second. Players will be warned that they need to damage the sphere before it explodes on them; if they don't, the sphere will explode after 15 seconds of charging and will instantly kill all players. If players succeed, the sphere will explode on the Brick-Titan and damage it. This attacked is used rarely.

As you have probably figured out by now, this is meant to be the toughest and most complicated boss to fight. All of the players' weapons would have infinite ammunition during this boss. The real, catch, though, is the Titan's shield. The shield only allows a single weapon type to damage it, and it switches modes every 30 seconds. The modes are: Main, Medium and Light, Heavy, Long, Secondary, Specials, and Disabled. It will be announced when the mode is switched, and players will also be told what weapon type to use. The "Disabled" mode means any weapon will work. To make it more fair, a certain mode, after being selected randomly, could not be selected again until all other modes are activated.

At 1/2 or Less Health:
The Brick Titan will make a loud mechanical noise and turn red for a moment.
- Time between attacks slightly shortened
- Ballistic Fury lasts for 8 seconds; Titan's Drill for 9.
- Hell's Rain summons an extra missile for each player.

At 1/4 or Less Health:
The Titan will now be red and puff angry smoke while at this health level.
- Time between attacks shortened further.
- Ballistic Fury and Titan's Drill lasts for 10 seconds.
- Atomic Fission takes 13 seconds to kill all players.
- Artillery Trackers have 50% more health.

title: Some new tweaks, ideas, and changes that might sound a good idea. I guess.

posts.h:
Hello, Brick-Forcers and the New Brick-Force Developers and Moderators. I have some great ideas that might make this game more balancing and better. There will be 4 sections (or parts) I will share with you peoples to make this game more fair and fun.

PART 1
Advanced Graphic Settings
I know most people out there in Brick-Force are somehow having an unexpected freeze or maybe a lack of frame per seconds while playing. I don't think setting the Graphic all the way down doesn't seem to fix this, so I decided to make an idea for new and better Graphic Settings. Or alternatively if you want to make the game look so smooth and beautiful, then this might attract your attentions.

  • Bobbing (ON/OFF) = This might slightly increase the frame per seconds due to the animation of bobbing arms/weapons.
  • Particles (ON/OFF) = This allows you to see either you want to see particles from firing a weapon (like those star and bubbles), explosions, breaking glass, etc.
  • Weapon POV Positions (Left/Middle/Right) = I know most people out there are either left-handed or right-handed and want to make the weapon positioning more appropriate to peoples who are either lefties or righties. For example, you're left-handed and the weapon positioning is in the right side and you'll might get confused that you're right handed. Unlike most other FPS games, most FPS games do have this kinds of options like Sudden Attack, Counter Strike : Global Offensive, and so on. And don't ask about the Middle mode, DOOM fans will understand what I'm talking about.
  • Players Animations (ON/OFF) = Players animation has some problems that causes minor (or maybe major) frame per seconds problems. Turning it off may look the players freeze and don't do anything or maybe move around even though their body doesn't move, but it may able to slightly increase more FPS.
  • Non-players Animations (ON/OFF) = Animations from fires, bullets, reloading, etc. are the major things that make the game freeze and stutter hard as hell. The smoke animations are a good example because smoke are annoying as hell. Disabling non-players animation are recommend for players who have major FPS issues. But it may look ugly during gameplay but just like what those options says in Counter Strike 1.6: *Looks ugly, but faster gaming.*
posts.t: Some new tweaks, ideas, and changes that might sound a good idea. I guess.

posts.h:
PART 2
Weapon Balancing
Most people out there are complaining about how most people uses the same gun over and over again. Spider 36 is a good example, or maybe a Thornblaster. Most people out there uses Light weapons than any weapon categories (well depends on what map they play). So we want to change that, making people to use different kinds of people to make the players to find their own unique weapons that suits them well. (And again I don't know what was I talking about but you'll understand what i'm talking about.)

  • Light Weapons = The weapons will have a very accurate crosshair, but the crosshair will enlarge very quick due to the massive rate of fire while shooting. So shooting as you hold down your mouse button will reduce your light weapon accuracy by 10%. So tapping your mouse for burst control will be recommended to control your accuracy. The light weapons are meant for close combat situations, not for everything.
  • Medium Weapons = The weapons will become very accurate even while shooting, but slower rate of fire and high recoil. Burst firing the mediums weapons will recommend for long range combat and auto firing for medium combat. But because the weapons are very accurate and have slower rate of fire, it's not suited well for Close combat situations.
  • Semi-Automatic Long Weapons = There are no problems or require balancing for Long Weapons that has a massive damage, but a Long Weapons that has extreme rate of fire like Cobra 42, Viper 1, Rattler 42. Any assigned Long Range weapons that are semi-automatic will have a revamped scope function that acts like a normal Medium Weapon scope, allowing the semi-automatic to fire consecutively while aiming down scope. Dealing enemies massive damage in close to medium range combat.
  • Close/Melee Weapons = There should be alternate attack function which allows the players to swing their Melee slower than the primary attack but deals more damage than the normal swing. To balance things out, the primary attacks to most Melee Weapons will swing faster but deals less damage, and the alternate attack to deal massive damage but slower swing.
  • Aiming Down Scopes = While Aiming down your weapon's scope, your movement speed will decrease by 50% but greatly increases the accuracy and significantly decreases the recoil while shooting. Doing this while crouching will make you move slow but make the accuracy more extreme and reduces the recoil massive. But there should be an animation for players as they aim down to their scopes, so that way other players can see either your aiming down your scope or not.
  • Secondaries = Any secondaries that packs massive damage like Eagle 12, Hawk 14, Delta, etc. will have improved damage and accuracy, but slower rate of fire and higher recoil. Power pistol are meant for players who knows how to lock on their target and aim properly. Any secondaries that are automatic like Falcon 20, Osiris, Piranha, etc. will have moderate accuracy but poor accuracy while firing full-auto, but high rate of fire and ammo capacity. Rapid pistol are for peoples who loves close combat situations.
  • Specials (Or Grenades we may call it) = Specials that explodes on contact like Easter Egg, Snowball Menace, etc. will have decreased Radius Effect but massive damage and cannot explode on time fuse, but only when the grenades hit an objects in order to explode. Any grenades that has their own fuse time to explode like Big Bang 400, Black Powder Bomb, Cactus Bomb, etc. will have even wider radius effect and moderate damage. Which you don't need to worry if you see enemy's Big Bang 400 rolls slowly in front of you.
  • Heavy Weapons = Any machine guns will have the most massive damage per second than any weapon category but higher recoil and unstable accuracy controlling while shooting. Shotguns however don't seem to have problems today because that's how shotguns goes. But not the Hellgate, it should have either massive damage or pellet per shots. OneXz approves it's the most worthless shotgun than any other FPS game shotgun in history.

PART 3
Advanced Shop/Iventory Systems
You thought that there's nothing missing in the Shop or in the Inventory? Think again.

  • "Try Out" System = This idea was inspired by Blueboy6. If you're really not sure if this weapon is worth buying, why not trying it out... FOR FREE? There should be a "Try Out" button for testing out any weapons you want to test to see if this is your perfect for you to buy. If you choose "Try Out", it will give you a chosen weapon you wanted to try for 2 hour, however your kills or scores won't count when using the weapon you wanted to try it out. Don't just waste your Tokens or Force-Points to buy weapons you need for Permanent or for 1 Day to see if it's your perfect weapon... Try It Out.
  • Selling System = Everybody, have a lots of old item they purchased and don't want it anymore. So what do they want? Well, selling system brings them their attentions. Selling System only works any items that is permanent. The selling price will be 50% of the original price of any items you purchased. If the item has an upgrade in it, it will increase the selling price. The more upgrade it has, the more refunds you will get it back.
  • Gifting 2.0 = Now most moderators or staff complains that gifting is banned permanently, but we want gifting system be added to the game again. But this time, it will be different. The players who gifts items to another player will give them a inbox message. If the player have the gift message from the person, the players either have two options: either Accept, or Decline. If the player accepts the gift, then the player who gifted that person will lose the money. But, if the player declines the gifts, then the player who gifted that person will receive their moneys back. It acts same function as Clan Invitations, but instead you'll either you accept the gift or decline the gift.

PART 4
Advanced Gameplay Mechanics/Systems
Trust me, you will agree on my ideas, and also some of my friend's ideas for this sections.

  • Advanced and New Spectator Mode = There must be a First-Person View and "Free Roaming" camera mode to spectate and see what's happening during the gameplay more accurately. Making it only Third-Person view is terrible, why not add more different types of Spectating Modes?
  • Breakable Bricks = Any breakable bricks like Fragile Wooden Box, Glass, etc. are able to respawn per every round like Defusion, Capture the Flag, Zombie mode, etc. and also respawn on its own during the certain time in order to respawn. Because no wonder why Dusty is the most worse Zombie mode map in history.
  • More Gameplay Options = Drops, Auto-Balance, Mid-Game Joining, and Wanted are not enough. I found this idea somewhere in Brick-Force's Facebook Comment Posts and have this excellent idea: No Grenade Mode, No Armor Mode, and No Action Panel Mode. This three additional options will be shown under the old four checkmark options. These three options will make the gameplay extremely fair between players who are weak and players who are strong. And this three options will affect in all mode except Freefall and Escape mode.
  • Customizable Crosshair = People has their own different styles when they use different types of weapons, this setting will only appear only in the Graphic settings. This allows you to customize your crosshair's shape, colors, and style. Because why not?
  • Revamped Minimap System = What you will see is only your teammates, your dead teammates, and A/B bombsites. This minimaps requires more icon so the players can understand the situations. There should be an icon for enemy's activities. [!] for if the enemy is firing a weapons or been hit by your teammates. [?] for if the enemy activities had faded away from you and your teammates. and [X] for if the enemy player is killed.
  • Advanced Voting System = Nothing bad about it, but ofcourse the way you vote. Voting via menu makes most player difficult (most players conform is because they're lazy, which doesn't make sense). Instead of voting via menu, they most vote WHILE PLAYING. So like for example, F7 for Agree/Yes and F8 for Disagree/No. That way the voting sessions will end quick and effeciently. Don't complain you're been vote kicked because you're "hacking", it happens a lot because you're too good.
  • Advanced Radio Communications = There should be MORE Radio Commands for your teammates to understand. We all know that people knew that you can jump on players head, but most people don't understand. So my ideas for adding new Radio Commands is "Climb at my head!", "Team, Split up!", and "Team, Stick together/Regroup"

My friends, that's all of my suggestive ideas I want to share for this new developers to work to make this game more fair and fun, I'll see you guys at the game and forum.

BUILD. SHARE. PLAY.

Sci-Fi Long Range Sniper Rifles now fires a streams of lasers, Sci-Fi Shotguns fires a massive colorful puffs that may leads projectile or range has the closest lasting range, but deals one-hit K.O. damage, Sci-Fi Grenades explodes into a massive colorful explosions, and any Sci-Fi weapons shoots thing that is so colorful that you want to let your enemies get distracted and get disintegrated.

It allows the shotgun reloads faster in any serious situations. Today's shotgun reloading mechanics is not what we expected. What if you just fired all of your shotgun's ammo in the middle of gun fight and it tooked you almost 3 second to reload all of those ammo in just one button pushed. We want shotguns reloads very tactical and useful, and that's how shotgun goes.
  • Advanced Defense Mode = Bees now attack you but not only by touching you, but by shooting at you. This is bad news for players who just likes to farm bees for XPs and Force-Points. Bigger Bosses deals more damage than normal bees in Defense mode, and yes even the normal bees are allowed to shoot, too. But be glad your Team's Bee knows what team you're in.

title: Bullet Penetration, Bullet Debuffs, and Bullet Projectiles.

posts.h:
Turning Simple and Casual Shootings into Intense and Competitive Shootings.

Hello, Brick-Forcers.
I have somehow had an excellent idea as I was playing some CS:GO and Team Fortress 2. Watching my AWP penetrate through thin doors and enjoying lighting up my opponents with my Flare Gun. I was hoping, if there could be this new gameplay mechanic called Bullet Penetration, Bullet Debuffs and Bullet Projectiles. It's time to balance some weapons.

Bullet Penetration.
This gameplay mechanic ideas grants most primary/secondary weapons the ability to fire bullets that can penetrate through blocks and also ignores armor. Perhaps a bit more Counter-Strike related ideas, but it has to happen. Interesting enough that I see lots of players using Spider 36 extremely common, so I decided to bring up this idea so that most players has its own advantages not to use only Spider 36, but a different weapon that has higher penetration than their same weapons that they used to use. The list below shows you Weapon Category's Penetration Levels. The possible Penetration level are 10.

  • Lights = 1 ~ 3 Penetration Level (1 Block Thick)
  • Mediums = 4 ~ 6 Penetration Level (2 Blocks Thick)
  • Longs = 7 ~ 10 Penetration Level (3 Blocks Thick)
  • Machine Guns (Heavy) = 3 ~ 5 Penetration Level (2 Block Thick)
  • Shotguns (Heavy) = 1 ~ 2 Penetration Level (1 Block Penetration)
  • Explosive Launcher (Heavy) = 0 Penetration Level (No Block Penetration)

Secondaries in the other hand, also has its own Penetration Level, but less Block Penetration.

  • Automatic/Machine Pistols = 1 ~ 3 Penetration Level (No Block Penetration)
  • Semi-Automatic Pistols = 4 ~ 6 Penetration Level (1 Blocks Thick)
  • Magnum Pistols = 7 ~ 10 Penetration Level (2 Blocks Thick)

Penetration Level also has this mechanic called Armor Penetration where High-Penetration Level Weapons (Dark Thunder for example) can damage player's health more often than their armor (Basically it either takes out enemy's armor more efficiently or ignores armors and allowing its bullet to damage only their health). If you have an enemy sniper that has a Snake, which has 10 Penetration Level, you better find some cover or else you'll never see the light again.

Penetration Level
  • Level 1 = 5% Armor Penetration
  • Level 2 = 10% Armor Penetration
  • Level 3 = 15% Armor Penetration
  • Level 4 = 20% Armor Penetration
  • Level 5 = 25% Armor Penetration
  • Level 6 = 30% Armor Penetration
  • Level 7 = 35% Armor Penetration
  • Level 8 = 40% Armor Penetration
  • Level 9 = 45% Armor Penetration
  • Level 10 = 50% Armor Penetration

This may also brings good news to Beginner Channel Players that Thunder 47 may be their good weapon choice if this new gameplay mechanic is added to the game. Season 3 Weapons however does not have its own Penetration Level, but have something interesting, which we will go through about that today as you read my ideas.
posts.t: Bullet Penetration, Bullet Debuffs, and Bullet Projectiles.

posts.h:
Bullet Debuffs.

Bullet Debuffs is a mechanic that allows most of the weapons the ability to damage players and leaving them some debuffs. Most of the elemental-based weapons like Burning Hurricane or Snow Hornet has not only Bullet Penetration but also some chances that its bullet can also give the opponents debuffs. I have currently made 6 Bullet Debuffs Ideas.

Bleeding!

Bleeding Debuffs can be found commonly in Season 3 Weapons (arrow-based weapons), because an arrow to the knee is painful, yes? When you're affected by Bleeding Debuffs, your Health Points slowly drains till it either player's health reaches 0 or for short period of time (Maximum Duration : 5 Seconds. Every 1 second drain 5 Health Points)

Burning!

Burning Debuffs can be found commonly in any fire-based Weapons (for example, Jupiter or Hellfire Crossbow) and allows the player to be lit on fire when for short period of time and deals more damage than Bleeding debuff's. Dealing 10 Damage per seconds, Burning Debuff can last for 5 Seconds which leads 50 damage total. The Flame and the Explosive Barrel (which can be found in Build Mode) also have the Burning Debuff effect.

Frozen!

Frozen Debuffs can be found commonly in any ice-based Weapons (for example, Snow Hornet or Snow Menace) and reduces player's movement speed for short period of time. It doesn't deal damage when the player is under effect of Frozen Debuff, but you're movement will either freeze or decrease. Probably why staying cool is a bad idea.

Poisoned!

Poison Debuffs can be found commonly in any poison/radioactive-based Weapons (for example, Anubis or Poisonous Bomb) and it does same thing what the Bleeding Debuffs do, but instead: It has higher duration and drains energy very effectively until your Health Points reaches 1 or at the end of the duration of the debuff. This also have something interesting: In Zombie Mode, if you're using a Poison/Radioactive-based Weapons onto a Zombie, you're not just dealing damage or giving the zombie debuff, YOU'RE JUST GIVING THE ZOMBIE MORE HEALTH. Toxic Barrel (which can be found in Build Mode) also have Poison Debuff.

Shocked!

Shock Debuff can be found commonly in any electric-based Weapons (like Taser or Fancy Justice) and have this interesting effect. Once you're affected by this debuff, you don't feel anything for a while. Duration is 10 seconds, and during those 10 seconds, you have a chance to be paralyzed and take massive damage (20 damage per shock). However, you have a chance not to get the most tremendous shock during those 10 seconds if you're lucky.

Soaked!
[Preview of this Image can not be shown due to its Picture Attachment Limits]
Now this Debuff is interesting. Soaked Debuff can be found commonly in any water-based Weapons (like the Octopus Cannon or the Ball-E) and it doesn't cause damage but it reduces player's weapon reload and switch speed. The duration is 10 seconds, and if you're soaked you have to find a spot to hide so you can wait till the Soaked Debuffs wears off.

Perhaps the Colorful weapons like Jupiter, Anubis, Fancy Roller, etc. doesn't have penetration level, but have more chance creating debuffs than modern-style weapons. Would you use a Burning Hurricane that have 25% chance creating Burning Debuff or use a Jupiter that have 75% chance creating Burning Debuff? Colorful Weapons may have higher chance creating debuffs, but to balance that out: they're not going to shoot a bullet that go Zing but a projectile that goes Zoom!

Here's the picture of Soaked! Debuff:

Moving On...

Bullet Projectiles

Now, Bullet Projectiles is a new mechanic that allows Sci-Fi/Colorful Based Weapons to fire projectiles. Think about a Plasma Rifle from Doom 3, maybe easy to dodge those Plasma Balls, but perhaps it also deals short splash damage. So, you don't worry about your colorful weapons (that fire projectiles) if you miss a shot, because you might able to hit the target by splash damage. But becareful, not only splash damage can affect enemy but it can also affect to you, too! So if you have a E7 Plasma Rifle (like me), you better maintain your distance while firing.

Each Weapon Category has its own Bullet Projectile Sizes and they way they act.
  • Lights = Small Orb/Laser/Bullet then small splash damage
  • Mediums = Medium Orb/Laser/Bullet then medium splash damage
  • Longs = (First) Fast and Straight Trail of Orb/Laser/Bullet. (Once Hit) Then Medium splash damage.
  • Machine Guns (Heavy) = Small Orb/Laser/Bullet then small splash damage
  • Shotguns (Heavy) = Large Wave (Imagine firing a Jupiter that fires a wave of fire.)
  • Secondaries = Tiny Orb/Laser/Bullet then tiny splash damage

That's all of my Brick-Force ideas today. If you think this is a good or a bad idea, let me know.
See you guys in the game and forum.

I am going to throw in my own opinion here.

First I'd like to bring up server related topics, and community relations:
I believe the US server closing brought together the remaining community into a centralized play area in which could be enjoyed. The US and EU users may not get along as well as they should, but we need to remember, as a community that we are in this together. Flaming and raging over a specific demographic of users being better or worse is not a way to handle the situation, but rather to better yourself, or help better others so that they can contend with other users. This goes for all users, not just English users. Treat others the way you wish to be treated, and you will have a much more fun and meaningful experience within the Brick-Force servers.

The next point I wish to talk about is that you mention a lack of balancing:
If you know how the game works, and know little secrets then you can overpower those who are using a pure token-purchased arsenal, but will have to be patient when you do die. Remember the part about keeping a cool head and remembering that there is a person just like you on the opposing end who will have the same feelings if they die, especially if they're KDR nuts. (I am not saying I believe it is not an issue, and I do agree that things do need to be done to enhance the game play for newbies)

The third point I am going to cover is Infernum's lack of sales:
The lack of sales is brought up quite frequently, but please look at this in a lighter way. Yes people are purchasing tokens every day in hopes there will be some sales, but we need to remember that the reason behind the unbalance people complain about are the sales everyone is missing.

As a whole I would like to say that the game is doing fine and has a strong amount of potential if a couple of major issues were dealt with. If the US server were to open again, more than 30 people would have to be online at a time for it to be justifiable. Janot, you stated there were around 100 people on at some points. Yes, at some points, but that was highly uncommon, and it was more common for there to be less than 10 people online at a time.

I would also like to point out that this could be a fairly controversial topic, and if it begins to land into a flame war the thread will be closed without any hesitation.

Hello. I have been playing Brick-force for a few years now, and I have to speak up about how unfortunate the state of the game has become.

I went the longest time without having to spend a dime on Brick-force but eventually gave in, thinking that it would possibly, by some miracle help. I can attest to the fact that without paying, the player is completely doomed in winning the majority of the time. The design of having to continually spend the force points means there is never a way to save the force points, as well as token-only equipment/weapons for the payees. Now that I have purchased tokens I can also say it does not help much either. There needs to be a way for non-payers to have just as much chance of winning as the payees.

If the pay to win is not bad enough, the game has become increasingly problematic with the ongoing cheating/glitching/hacking. That now means that not only are the non-paying players doomed, but the players who have put out the money and choose not to cheat are also doomed. It's terrible that there has to actually be a report option of hacking set within the game itself. I've sent many of these reports and still find no progress or resolution. I've seen cheating players who can move incredibly quick, can fly/float in the air, can shoot through bricks, can cross over to another teams side and mess with their map/build, and players who seem to be invincible to any weapons. It's become a joke!

Brick-force has potential to be a great game, which is why I still play, but it is hindered so badly by these problems. I often wonder whenever I play, why exactly do the game developers allow this to go on? Can they not start cracking down on cheaters and get to work fixing this game for everyone to have a more enjoyable experience? I would really like to hear back from the developers in this post for an explanation. The honest Brick-force players deserve better.

Other issues worth noting are the network failures in the game, and inappropriate language/maps. Thank you.

-Amity-Owl
posts.t: The unfortunate state of this game.

-Elevator(In addition to ladders, there could be elevators that take the player up and down to different floors. This would work similar to the Train Set, instead it would work vertically.)

-Liquid bricks(Bricks that would appear as having a water/poison/lava/etc. textured animation. The player would be able to go within the brick. Each different kind could affect the player in a different fashion.)

title: can some of this have a chance of being added?
Better and Balanced Usage of Coins

posts.h:
Hello, Brick-Soldiers and Brick-Builders.

I have a brilliant and suggestive idea that we, the Brick-Soldiers, can may think and use the Pic 'n' Win coins more effectively and in such fair way. But for now, I wanted to rename Pic 'N' Win Coins into just "Coins", with good reason.

Instead of using just for only Pic 'N' Wins Board, it will be used in three ways:
  • XP Multiplier - to mutliply the XP gained after every match.
  • Force-Points Multiplier - to multiply the Force-Points gained after every match.
  • Pic 'N' Win Board - to try their best and luck to win fabulous items from the Pic 'N' Win boards.

The way the Multiplier works is that players must spend at least 4 Coins in order to increase the Multiplier level. All players will start with 1.00x Multiplier and it will increase if the players decided to either spend Coins on increasing Multiplier or alternatively spend them on Pic 'N' Win boards to get Rare Items.

And how the Multiplier works, let us say that (for example) you are the Soldier who had 500 Force-Points gained after every match as your Force-Points Multiplier is 1.00x. But, with Multiplier increases by 2.00x (which is the maxed level) you will instead gain 1,000 Force-Points after every match, thanks to your increased Multiplier.

In order to increase your multiplier to the max (which is 2.00x), players must spend 16 Coins in order to max a single multiplier, but to max your second multiplier it will cost you another 16 Coins which is 32 Coins total for upgrading two of your Multiplier to the max.

Multiplier Upgrade Levels
  • 1.00x (Default/Level 1) : 0 Coin used. Upgrade Level 0
  • 1.00x (+25%) : 1 Coin used. Upgrade Level 1
  • 1.00x (+50%) : 2 Coins used. Upgrade Level 2
  • 1.00x (+75%) : 3 Coins used. Upgrade Level 3
  • 1.25x (Level 2) : 4 Coins used. Upgrade Level 4
  • 1.25x (+25%) : 5 Coins used. Upgrade Level 5
  • 1.25x (+50%) : 6 Coins used. Upgrade Level 6
  • 1.25x (+75%) : 7 Coins used. Upgrade Level 7
  • 1.50x (Level 3) : 8 Coins used. Upgrade Level 8
  • 1.50x (+25%) : 9 Coins used. Upgrade Level 9
  • 1.50x (+50%) : 10 Coins used. Upgrade Level 10
  • 1.50x (+75%) : 11 Coins used. Upgrade Level 11
  • 1.75x (Level 4) : 12 Coins used. Upgrade Level 12
  • 1.75x (+25%) : 13 Coins used. Upgrade Level 13
  • 1.75x (+50%) : 14 Coins used. Upgrade Level 14
  • 1.75x (+75%) : 15 Coins used. Upgrade Level 15
  • 2.00x (MAX Level) : 16 Coins used. Upgrade Level 16/MAX
Keep in mind that the +25%, +50%, and +75% will not slightly increase the multiplier, the percentage are meant to display the upgrade process you have done.

However, to make this fair and challenging, the Coins Chargers must be removed from the Shop permanently and the Multiplier Upgrade Levels will degrade by -1 Upgrade Level EVERY WEEK. That way, it will make the players to focus on their Daily Missions more than just having fun in most matches and battles they compete with others. Players will have an optional choice is to either focus on increasing their multipliers by completing Daily Missions every day; a choice where players decide to play and focus on having fun more than completing Daily Missions; or alternatively both.

That's all I can possibly think of ideas I can think of to share it with you, Brick-Soldiers. I hope most of you can think of this kinds of great ideas and share it to others as well. Everyone have a brilliant ideas of their own to share with friends and other members to the Community.

Bye guys, see you guys at the Forum.

posts.h:
You've seen 5 empty slots for your consumable Action Panels. But how will you like if there was an additional empty slot(s) for a permanent perk(s) during the battlefield?


Hello, Brick-Soldiers and Brick-Brains.
I have another brilliant ideas that if there was an another empty slot(s) that will display bottom of your screen like action panels, but instead of for consumable action panels: it will be a acquired perk(s) for your battlefield, aka Battle Panel.

Because simply enough, most players may or may not have the advantage to fight against other players that have their advantage to fight against them. But with the perks, there will be many players around the Brick-Wide, World to have their unique fighting style and their own advantage to fight against most players. Meaning that most players will be fair to each other in most matches with the perks.

You can also view your enemy's perks that can be shown next to the 'Wanted' cam once you are killed, which allows you to know what perks that your enemy that killed you is using to use their advantage to fight against you.

However, I will create a poll to make you guys think "Which is the fair way to use perks if this was really released and implemented to the game?" The lists of perks will be posted below this post.

There will be 3 categories of Perks, each categories carrying many types of perks that will may be very useful to you. The three categories of perks will affect on:

  • Weapons (making most of weapons you own even powerful and useful with many variants of Weapons perks.)
  • Players (make your character more reliable and in tip-top shape in most scenarios and situations.)
  • Worlds (make your match more intense and easier to finish with these types of helpful perks.)

Now the three categories will also have list of many types of useful perks.

Weapons perks.
  • P.O.W.erful Punch: Increases melee damage.
  • Bulkier Shells: Increases Shotgun's damage per pellets.
  • Mystic Bullets: All weapon's damage increases as ammunition in magazines decreases.
  • Angry Bomb: Increases Special's damage.
  • Long Barrel: Increases the Range of your Weapons.
  • Full-Metal Jacket: Increases Medium's damage.
  • Big Bomb: Increases Special's effect radius.
  • Double Magazine: Doubles the amount of extra ammunition to carry, but decreases the mobility.
  • Anti-Tank Bullets: Increases Sniper's damage.
  • Custom Mechanism: Increases weapon's rate of fire.
  • Elder Bomb: Increases Special's effect duration.
  • Sharpshooter Barrel: Increases weapon's accuracy.
  • Supreme Bullet: Increases machine gun's damage.
  • Light-Weighted Swings: Increases melee speed.
  • NANO Bullets: Increases Light's damage.
  • Hot Rod Mechanism: Increases rate of fire as ammunition in magazines decreases.
  • Recoil Suppressor: Decreases weapon's recoil.

Players perks.
  • Swift Hands: Increases reload speeds.
  • Cold-Hearted: Allows your character to be undetectable from enemy's Heart Beat Radars.
  • Medical Doctor: Increases the amount of health gain from potions, and able to share health from potions to teammates by using the potions next to them.
  • Heavy Armor: Greatly increases armor, but decreases the movement speeds.
  • Stamina Overload: Increases the sprint duration.
  • Danger Sense: Greatly increases the danger awareness and range of enemy's thrown/placed specials from far distances.
  • Stealth Boots: Unable to create sound by walking, running, jumping, and landing.
  • Dualies: Allows you to dual-wield the same pistol you equipped from your inventory, but decreased mobility and increases recoil.
  • Trigger Finger: Increases rate of fire to all ranged weapons.
  • Hawk Eye: Increases accuracy to all weapons.
  • Scavenger: Allows you to scavenge ammunition from fallen enemies and teammates.
  • Marksman: Accuracy and damage increases +1% at every bullet hit to enemies. If one bullet misses, it will reset back to 0%
  • Martyrdom: Upon death, players will cause to drop a live Special (depends on what Special you equipped.)
  • Full Focus: Your aim will no longer goes down once you've been hit from an enemy.
  • Strong Knees: Decreases fall damage.
  • Ghost Body: Have a half chance to bypass enemy's placed Boomslang.

Worlds perks.
  • Last Man Standing: Increases accuracy, damage, rate of fire, and ammunition only if you're marked as last living player in any Defusion/Zombie mode. However, you will be permanently detectable to enemy's radar until the round is over.
  • Flag of Power: Increases mobility and damage to any weapons upon carrying the flag.
  • Underdog: Allows you to detect an enemy who's carrying the flag or defusing/planting the bomb.
  • Quick Action: Decreases the time required to plant and defuse the bomb. But causes a wide noise.
  • Silence Action: Defusing and Planting the bomb will cause no sounds. But takes longer time to plant and defuse.
  • Grey Matter: Weapon's accuracy and damage increases depends on the amount of Brick-Shot you made in every round in Zombie mode.
  • Recycle: Automatically replenish used magazine at every kills from the opposing team.
  • Infection Rampage: Gives 2 seconds of Warpies per every infection you made to Brick-man.
  • Books of Knowledge: Gives players +50% XP Bonus.
  • Bags of Fortune: Gives players +50% Force-Points Bonus.
  • Peeking: Gives you the ability to see through enemy's sides during Build phase in B'n'D mode.
  • Bee's Vengeance: Players and anyone who is near a player who have this perks will have increased damage and rate of fire for 2 seconds once the enemy have destroyed the friendly's Boss Bee.

  • Jammed Gun: Every starting match you initiate have a chance to remove all upgrade points to all player's upgraded weapons until the game is over.

We had this kind of idea few years ago which has no solutions to remove them, but be smart about it and know how to evaluate the map rating or reporting the map to consider it as abusive or broken.

So far, as all I can know about what needs to be change or needs to be added in the near-future patch or update is that there needs to be some weapons the needs to be rebalance and change. There will be other feedback I would love to share it in this thread, but I may be running out of ideas or something that needs to be rebalanced.
  • The Gamma needs to have powerful damage or pellets per shot comparing to the Hydra Crossbow.
  • The Boomslang needs to have lower placement reach since right now the possible longest reach you can place is approximately 11 blocks away from the player.
  • The White Oblivion needs to have slightly less recoil and slightly higher accuracy since the stats for White Oblivion are identical to Desert Oblivion, but what's the small difference between Desert and White Oblivion is that White Oblivion only has 30 rounds per mag as Desert Oblivion has 22.
  • The Tarantual 41 needs to have higher ammo capacity per magazine (most other stats may remain unchange) due that judging the looks of the ammo drum on the Tarantula 41, it may seem to have more than 35 ammo per magazine. So I'm guessing increasing to 45 will do the trick.
  • The Locust 5 and Jungle Scarab need to have huge stats comparison differences, due that there is seem to be no reasons why Jungle Scarab will be worth buying due that Locust 5 is much more faster and easier to use comparing to Jungle Scarab (or to be fair, maybe Jungle Scarab can be purchased with Force-Points only as Locust 5 is for Tokens.) Jungle Scarab needs to have maybe 25% Damage instead of 24% due that it's +4% more recoil and -3% less accuracy than the Locust 5.
  • Fire Beetles 3S needs to be slightly more stronger and more reliable than Silver Beetle itself. The main difference between these two weapons is the ammo capacity per magazine and recoil. Since the damage and range is slightly identical to each other, I say that Fire Beetles 3S needs to be a REAL living inferno by slightly increasing the damage, but with less range. Fire Beetle 3S needs to have this "Rare" Marking next to it so people won't get confused that if it's either considered upgradeable or Rare.
  • Neutrino Rifle on the other hand, needs to be more faster and have the only highest RPM in the game, the damage and other stats are balanced out, but the rate of fire however needs to be buffed a little.
  • Hellgate, Cavalry, Sundance, Hawk 14 and Eagle 12 really (like really) needs to be buff as well. The damage doesn't seem to finish off the opponents the way we expected to be once we bought these five weapons. The Cavalry, Eagle 12, Hawk 14 and Sundance don't have enough powerful damage, range, and sharper accuracy to deal enemies serious damage in medium to long range. Hellgate however in the other hand needs to have its damage buffed because it has identical damage, pellets per shot, and accuracy (I think) like the Matizao Shotgun. Hellgate need to have either higher damage, pellets per shot, or alternatively a secondary fire where you load two shells in one.
  • Spider 36 is overly-used in most battles, starting from close to long range which is really ridiculous because of its range and other stats. Because of this, most players don't tend to use other weapons of their desire rather using Spider 36. The only way to encourage other players to use different weapons in different match and situations is by decreasing the accuracy and rate of fire; the recoil, and damage is considered not required to be changed.
  • The ammo in the weapon's stats needs to be change the way it displays. For example, I bought a Saurus 42 and I maxed it up, and the ammo now says is 300. Because of this, we don't even know how many ammo do all weapons have per magazine. Maybe if it's like 75/225 (instead of 300) will be easier to know how many ammo capacity do weapons they are about to purchase have.

Second of all, the information I give is mostly to combat the issue with noobs vs pro and to balance the Gameplay.

1 ) The amount of force point distribution is currently unfair, losing team get a significant less amount of force point then the winning team regardless of the kill. This is usually cause because one team has an overpowered P2W weapons with heavy armour whilst the opposite team is newly trainee. This is a big issue especially if one team is a hacker and it is also the reason why most people would rather go to the winning team just so that they can earn force points.

I know that Brick-Force was made in Unity 3D software, so the force point distributed uses math formula. So after multiple testing, hours of work and racking my brain (seriously, I spent a lot of time trying to get up a good equation for the game's sake) here is what I've came up with:

Force Point Earning = player kills * assist with 1 decimal place (so 39 assist becomes 3.9 assist) + total of opposition team ranking + player's XP (1 decimal place) * team kills and assist comparison * 1.5 (only for the winning team)

Team kills and assist comparison: 1 - assist (2 decimal places, 3 decimal place if 100, 4 decimal place if 1000 and so on)
The team and kills comparison is based of the working out of percentage increase and decrease calculation. Tell me what you think of this and what I need to change.

I'm sorry but all this pay to win talk is making me sick. To a certain extent it may be true, i.e. force point nades are no match for token nades. However, I suspect many players use 'p2w' as an excuse to justify why they cannot defeat certain enemies. When this occurs, players no longer strive to use different means and strategies to overcome their nemesis. Which is a self fulfilling prophecy. Where there is a will, there is always a way. By accepting the 'p2w' excuse you give up hope, which leads to more loss. Before the shutdown of the US server I was sponsoring a friend of mine, posesa. After buying him 30,000 tokens and watching him play using token armor and weapons I can say with all honesty that his gameplay and KD did not improve. What did improve, was the rate at which he was scoring, i.e. as a f2p player he would get 10 kills and 4 deaths, as a token player he would get 20 kills and 8 deaths. In other words, having token weapons and armor didn't make a difference because the simple problem of him not being able to avoid dying. This I believe, is the key that is often overlooked. Being good at FPS games is not all about being able to kill enemies, its also and more importantly, about not letting your enemies kill you. This is all I will say for now as I am pressed for time ATM. Hopefully this helps clear a few things up and put others into proper perspective.

Hello, Brick-Forcers.

I have some ideas that can surely balance out some weapon's stats and usage. So players can tend to use different weapon for their own advantages depending on what map they are in.

We should include this new weapon/shooting mechanic called "Auto-Fire Accuracy" and "Spread Recovery".

It will be like below Accuracy stats for all Main and Secondary weapon's stats. And to understand what is Auto-Fire accuracy: It will be a new stats for Main and Secondary weapon that will determine how accurate the weapon will be when auto-firing till the ammo in magazine is empty. This idea was inspired by the Tachyon Blaster's descriptions, well not 100% accurate of what it said : If you fire Tachyon Blaster too long, it's accuracy will be wider and spreads bigger. The Spread Recovery will be about how long it take to recover the wide spread crosshair to its original crosshair.

The relationship between Auto-Fire Accuracy and Spread Recovery is that as the player Auto-Fire too much, the crosshair will bloom or spread really high, and with Bloom Recovery it will take some time to make the player's weapon wide spread accuracy to recover to its original crosshair.

Because of this idea, maybe it would be wise to include the Auto-Fire Accuracy stats for Main and Secondary weapons and even when using scope, it will be inaccurate if you auto-fire with scope for a long time. However like Accuracy and other non-upgradeable weapon stats, the Auto-Fire Accuracy and Spread Recovery can not be upgradeable as well.

So I'm determined that if these two stats were implemented to the game, most of the weapons will be balanced and allow players to use different weapons.

If you guys think this idea is good and want to support this idea, please feel free to share!

i think this would greatly improve the games realism. having a mechanic like this would make the game more believable and understanding of real life shooting, and not only that, it would make the daym thorn blaster no longer op. I understand it is difficult having to deal with a community of players who are accustomed to sales being done a certain way(which wasn't really paying off for infernum anyways). I think a good start would be having rotating sales every so often, where only a handful of items would be on sale for a decent price and they can be permanent items. Another area of improvement would be Premium accounts, it just isn't enough to justify the cost, auto heal takes up one space in action panel and does nothing that any skilled player with fast fingers cannot do. The Medium Weapons, Long Range Weapons, Heavy Weapons, and other weapons are seemed fine but the Light Weapons are literally not right. They're Light Weapons, Sub Machine Guns. They need to be really inaccurate that is capable of for close range only. And I don't care about your complaints or arguing that Spider 36 needs to be nerfed. It has to be nerfed for good.

For my suggestion and my ideas for balancing and nerfing all of the Light Weapons is to reduce all of the Light Weapon's damage by 5% and reduce the accuracy for all of the Light Weapon's accuracy by 3%. Other stats and specs however seems alright and fine. Beside, all of the Light Weapons have better recoil control and is only capable of close range combat.
